description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Attach a custom domain (e.g. mycoffeeshop.com or www.mycoffeeshop.com) to one of the user's CloudSites, the same as "Attach Custom Domain" in the GearHost panel. Works on every plan, including free. Afterwards the domain's DNS must point at the site: the result lists the exact records to add at the domain's DNS host. HTTPS is issued automatically once DNS resolves; get_domain_status reports progress. Returns structuredContent { status, domain, site, attached, records:[{ type, host, value }], next }.

domain.description: The custom domain to attach, e.g. "mycoffeeshop.com".

site.description: The CloudSite to attach to, by its current address (e.g. "glowing-raven.gearhost.io"; list_my_sites shows them).

name: attach_custom_domain
title: Attach custom domain
